name: corner
expr: C = corner(I); nC = size(C,1); c11 = C(1,1); c12 = C(1,2); c41 = C(4,1); c42 = C(4,2); Ca = corner(A); nA = size(Ca,1); ca51 = Ca(5,1); Cn = corner(A,2); nN = size(Cn,1); Cw = corner(W,1); cw11 = Cw(1,1); Cme = corner(I,'MinimumEigenvalue'); nMe = size(Cme,1);
comment: Sig: C = corner(I [, METHOD] [, N] [, 'QualityLevel'/'SensitivityFactor'/'FilterCoefficients', val]). Detect corner points by wrapping the shipped cornermetric: local maxima above QualityLevel*max -> connected-peak centroids -> strength-descending sort (ties by column-major/find order) -> up to N [x y]=[col row] integer coords. Border excluded naturally (metric <=0 < threshold). numkit's cornermetric matches MATLAB to ~1e-8 (not bit-exact), so the strength sort quantises to ~1e-9*max to reproduce MATLAB's bit-exact-symmetric equal-corner ordering. Fingerprint: bright square -> 4 corners [6 6;6 15;15 6;15 15]; two squares (contrast 1 vs 0.5) -> 8 with strong first (Ca(5,:)=[20 20]); N=2 truncates; strong-at-high-col W -> corner(W,1)=[20 20] (strength beats position); MinimumEigenvalue -> 4. Verified vs MATLAB R2025b. Fixes bugs/image/corner.
